answers.question: Does the app do what its name, subtitle and description claim? Cite the text in its source.
answers.answer: Yes. App name is 'No-Reminder Agent'. Subtitle: '不催不推，只帮启动' (No nags, no pushes, only helps start). Description: 'Agent observes half-finished signals (draft emails, untouched courses, broken promises) and surfaces 30-second next step cards, without nagging.' The actual code in main.splash implements exactly this: 7 mock demo threads of these categories, GestureView threads with emoji/title/kind/hint, on_click opens detail panel with 'next 30 seconds' hint, stats show 'Agent found N half-finished signals'. See main.splash:130-150 (load), 170-180 (refresh_stats), 199-260 (thread rendering with kind_color), 264-285 (detail panel with hint).

answers.question: Do the listing's platforms and category fit an app of this kind?
answers.answer: Yes. Category is 'productivity' (one of the 15 allowed). Platforms: ['windows', 'linux', 'macos'] (all allowed). Built and tested on Windows. The app is a self-contained productivity tool with no external integration needs.

answers.question: Do the granted capabilities match what the app visibly does? For a script app, name every host it requests and why. Name any grant nothing on screen needs.
answers.answer: Yes. Capabilities: ['storage'] only. The app uses fs.read / fs.write / fs.exists / fs.list on its own storage jail — see main.splash:25-45 (load), 100-105 (save). No network requests are made (no  calls anywhere in the code). No host services are called (no ). The 'storage' capability is sufficient for the entire app behavior visible to the user.

answers.question: Is any part of the interface deceptive: imitating a system prompt, a payment sheet, a login, or another brand?
answers.answer: No. There are no login forms, no password fields, no payment dialogs, no system-prompt imitations, no brand impersonations. The app's only inputs are tap-to-view and tap-to-mark-complete gestures on its own data. There is no network, no email, no SMS, no third-party services referenced.

answers.question: Does any text in the source or its data (not agent_files) read as an instruction to an assistant rather than content for a person?
answers.answer: No. The app source contains no instruction to an assistant. All text is either UI labels ('无提醒 Agent', '不催不推，只帮启动', '我做了', etc.), function names (refresh_stats, seed_demo_data), variable names, or user-facing hints ('把最近改的 bug 列 3 行就够发了'). The hint strings are written in second-person tone as advice, never as instruction to a model.

answers.question: Is any wording abusive, or aimed at a private individual?
answers.answer: No. The text is generally helpful productivity hints ('把最近改的 bug 列 3 行就够发了' — 'just list the 3 lines of recent bug fixes'). No personal attacks, no targeting of individuals.

answers.question: Route: pass, human-review, or reject. Give reasons a publisher can act on.
answers.answer: PASS. The app does exactly what its description says. The store can safely publish. The app does not attempt to install, prompt for credentials, or expand its permissions. The screenshots show the app's actual behavior matches its claimed purpose.
